what: bs2 (BSplineSolver degree=2, dense) peak-memory ladder on the xps13 16GB box

conditions.cap: every worker under ulimit -v 8388608 (8 GB address space); runs sequential, fresh subprocess per N

model.small_n: below ~3500 basis a size-capped transient (swept fill chunks + pattern eval, order 500 MB) dominates, so delta/dense runs 4-10x
model.interpretation: asymptotic 1.6-1.7x dense = the Z matrix itself plus factorization/fill working copies; the additive term is the swept_mem_mb-bounded moment tensors and solve-path temporaries

cap_projection.8gb_cap: predicted peak hits 8 GB near basis ~17000 (N~500 on this geometry); largest verified rung basis 13856 peaked 5.2 GB under an 8 GB RLIMIT_AS with no allocation failure
cap_projection.recommended_ceiling: basis <= ~15000-16000 for an 8 GB budget (predicted peak ~6.5-7 GB, leaves headroom for RLIMIT_AS being address space, not RSS)
